segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your admin profile?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel from Northstar Labeling, email is daniel.cho@northstarlabeling.com. I just need to add five user seats for our operations team before Monday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure. I have Northstar Labeling pulled up. You’re currently on the Team annual plan with 42 seats, renewal date November 18, 2026. Are you looking to move that to 47 seats today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Exactly. And if you can confirm what the prorated amount is, that’d be helpful for our PO.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, one moment while I check the billing tool. Okay, adding five seats today through your renewal comes to $1,184.25 before tax. It’ll appear on invoice INV-43891, generated today, with net 30 terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Can you go ahead and apply it?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. Your account now shows 47 seats. I also refreshed the admin console, so you should be able to invite those users right away under Users, then Invite users.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to do anything on the contract side, or is the invoice enough?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: For this plan, the invoice is enough. I’ve added a note in ticket 126744 that you approved the five-seat increase and the prorated charge. You’ll get the invoice and ticket summary by email in a minute or two.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that’s all I needed. Thanks, Maya.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. Have a good rest of your day.
